features.heading: Listings, Social, and SEO Monitoring — One Platform Under Your Brand
features.intro: Directory Listings combines local presence management with AI-powered social and SEO monitoring tools. You deliver a comprehensive digital foundation that SMBs actually use — and that drives recurring revenue with minimal support overhead.

cards.title: AI Auto-Reply
cards.body: Automatically respond to Facebook, Instagram, and Google reviews with AI-generated, on-brand replies. Owners approve or let it run — either way, every review gets handled quickly.

cards.title: Smart Dashboard
cards.body: A full overview of reviews, mentions, and ad performance in one centralized place. One login, one view, zero platform-hopping.

cards.title: Top Listings Sync
cards.body: Coordinate business details across dozens of top directories. Accurate listings drive local search visibility and keep customers' information consistent everywhere buyers look.

cards.title: AI Post Generator
cards.body: Generate and schedule on-brand content for Meta and Google platforms. Stay active online without hiring a copywriter or burning an afternoon every week.

cards.title: SEO Essentials
cards.body: Monitor key SEO performance indicators and surface actionable recommendations to improve rankings. Built-in feedback turns SEO into something an owner can actually act on.

cards.title: Performance Reporting
cards.body: See which profiles, posts, and directories drive calls, clicks, and conversions. Simple reports that make the product's value obvious at renewal time.

partnerAdvantage.heading: High Value, Low Cost — The Perfect Foundation Product
partnerAdvantage.intro: Directory Listings is your highest-attach digital product. It bundles naturally with everything else you sell, costs little to support, and creates the engagement that keeps customers in your ecosystem.

items.title: High value, comprehensive feature set at low cost
items.body: AI-powered social management, directory sync, review auto-reply, and SEO monitoring in one package. Delivers premium marketing capabilities that justify a recurring subscription — with margins that work at any scale.

items.title: Reduce churn with engaging essential tools
items.body: When SMBs use the product every week to manage listings, reviews, and posts, the platform becomes deeply embedded in their workflow. That regular usage creates the kind of stickiness that pure connectivity products can't match.

items.title: Bundle opportunity with hosting and website builder
items.body: Directory Listings pairs naturally with domains, hosting, and website builder to create ready-to-sell ARPU packages that deliver real value and are harder for competitors to unbundle.

items.title: Foundation for upselling to advanced features
items.body: Directory Listings is the natural stepping stone to Reputation Management, full SEO, advertising, and the complete marketing suite — turning basic tier customers into buyers of advanced ones.
